d: Watch as Firstpost examines the horrific humanitarian crisis in Sudan as the United Kingdom slaps sanctions on 15 senior commanders from both the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and the Rapid Support Forces (RSF). Following UK-funded investigations revealing that rape and starvation are actively weaponised in the conflict—most notably during the brutal siege and fall of El Fasher in North Darfur where thousands were slaughtered—London has moved to hold perpetrators accountable. With harrowing testimonies from survivors of sexual violence and new humanitarian funding announced, Firstpost breaks…
